theme_cn: 作文跟读 + AI口语 + Exercise02词汇 + 阅读理解 + 键盘拼写
reading_name: 阅读理解 · 库布其治沙

speaking.sentence: What do you think of the old arts in China, such as shadow puppetry?
speaking.sentence_cn: 你觉得皮影戏这样的中国老艺术怎么样？
options: I think they are amazing, because a small puppet can tell a whole story.
There are many old arts in China.
I watched a cartoon about a cat yesterday.
My grandpa is seventy years old this year.
options_cn: 我觉得它们很了不起，因为一个小皮影就能讲完一整个故事。
中国有很多古老的艺术。
我昨天看了一部关于猫的动画片。
我爷爷今年七十岁。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: amazing /əˈmeɪzɪŋ/ 重音在第二音节，puppetry /ˈpʌpɪtri/ 三个音节都要清楚
speaking.explanation_cn: 问的是「你觉得怎么样」，必须先表态再给理由。A 有 I think they are amazing + because；B 是客观叙述；C、D 完全没有说看法。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 先说 I think they are …，再用 because 说一条理由，比如有意思、有历史。

speaking.sentence: Would you like to learn shadow puppetry? Why?
speaking.sentence_cn: 你想学皮影戏吗？为什么？
options: Yes, I would love to, because I want to make my own puppet and tell a story with it.
Shadow puppetry is performed behind a screen.
I am very busy with my homework this week.
Many visitors watch puppet shows in the museum.
options_cn: 想，我很愿意，因为我想自己做一个皮影，用它来讲故事。
皮影戏是在幕布后面表演的。
我这周作业很多，很忙。
很多游客在博物馆看皮影戏。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: Would you 连读 /wʊdʒu/，puppet /ˈpʌpɪt/ 两个 p 只发一个音
speaking.explanation_cn: Would you like to…? 要先答 Yes 或 No，再讲原因。A 两项都有；B 是知识；C 说忙但没表态；D 说别人，答非所问。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 先回答 Yes, I would love to 或 No, thanks，再用 because 说原因。

speaking.sentence: What do you usually do in your art class at school?
speaking.sentence_cn: 你们学校的美术课通常做什么？
options: We usually draw pictures and sometimes make things with paper and clay.
My art teacher is a young woman.
I forgot to bring my colour pencils today.
There are forty students in my class.
options_cn: 我们通常画画，有时候用纸和橡皮泥做手工。
我的美术老师是一位年轻的女老师。
我今天忘了带彩笔。
我们班有四十个学生。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: usually /ˈjuːʒuəli/ 中间读 /ʒ/，clay /kleɪ/ 是橡皮泥、黏土的意思
speaking.explanation_cn: 问「通常做什么」，要用一般现在时讲习惯。A 说了画画的两种常做的事；B、D 介绍人和班级；C 说今天的一次疏忽。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 We usually + 动词原形，说出美术课上常做的两件事。

speaking.sentence: Which is more interesting to you, watching a film or watching a puppet show?
speaking.sentence_cn: 对你来说，看电影和看皮影戏哪个更有意思？
options: Watching a puppet show is more interesting, because the puppets are moved by real hands.
Films are shown in cinemas and on phones.
I watched two films during the holiday.
My cousin likes cartoon films very much.
options_cn: 看皮影戏更有意思，因为皮影是真人的手在操纵的。
电影在电影院和手机上都能看到。
假期里我看了两部电影。
我表弟非常喜欢动画电影。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: interesting /ˈɪntrəstɪŋ/ 重音在第一个音节，puppet 里的 t 要轻爆破
speaking.explanation_cn: 这是二选一，答句要选边并说明理由。A 选了皮影戏并给原因；B 讲电影的播放方式；C、D 说的是数量和别人，都没有比较。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 … is more interesting, because … 先选一个再讲理由。

speaking.sentence: How do old arts become popular again with young people?
speaking.sentence_cn: 老艺术怎样才能重新在年轻人中流行起来？
options: Old arts can become popular if schools teach them and videos show them in a fun way.
Old arts are hundreds of years old.
Some old arts are difficult to learn.
My teacher told us about an old art last week.
options_cn: 如果学校教这些老艺术，视频又把它拍得有趣，它们就能流行起来。
老艺术都有几百年历史了。
有些老艺术很难学。
上周老师给我们讲了一种老艺术。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: popular /ˈpɒpjələ/ 重音在前，if 引导条件句时读得轻快
speaking.explanation_cn: How 问方法，答句要给出做法。A 说了两条办法（学校教、视频拍得有趣）；B、C 是现状描述；D 说老师讲的内容，都没给办法。
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 … can … if … 说出办法，比如进课堂、拍短视频、做文创。

vocab.example_en: A group of us will have a barbecue this weekend.
vocab.example_cn: 我们这群人这周末要去烧烤。
vocab.hint_cn: 户外生火烤肉吃的那种聚会

vocab.example_en: I am going to the seaside for a holiday this summer.
vocab.example_cn: 今年夏天我要去海边度假。
vocab.hint_cn: sea 是大海，大海旁边的度假地

vocab.example_en: The actors said goodbye to all the audience.
vocab.example_cn: 演员们向所有观众道别。
vocab.hint_cn: 坐在台下看表演的一群人

vocab.example_en: The little boy bought a red balloon.
vocab.example_cn: 小男孩买了一个红气球。
vocab.hint_cn: 圆圆的、吹足气会飞上天的球

vocab.example_en: Yao Ming is an excellent Chinese basketball player.
vocab.example_cn: 姚明是一位出色的中国篮球运动员。
vocab.hint_cn: basket 是篮子，往篮里投的球

reading.passage: Kubuqi is a large desert in Inner Mongolia, and it is close to the Yellow River. Long ago the wind blew the sand into the river and over the farms, so people could not grow food there. In 1988 a farmer named Wang Wenbiao started to plant sand willows to stop the sand. Villagers also put dry straw into square grids on the sand, and grass came back inside the grids. Today more than half of the desert is green again, and birds and foxes have returned. Trains on the railway there no longer stop because of sandstorms.
reading.passage_cn: 库布其是内蒙古的一片大沙漠，它离黄河很近。很久以前，风把沙子吹进黄河、又吹到农田上，人们在那里种不出粮食。一九八八年，一位叫王文彪的农民开始种沙柳，用来挡住沙子。村民们还把干稻草铺成一个个方格压在沙上，草就在方格里长了出来。今天这片沙漠有一半以上又变绿了，鸟和狐狸也回来了。那里的火车再也不会因为沙尘暴而停下来。

questions.question: Where is the Kubuqi desert?
options: In Inner Mongolia
In Guangdong
On an island
Near Shanghai
questions.explanation_cn: 第一句说 Kubuqi is a large desert in Inner Mongolia（在内蒙古），它靠近黄河。

questions.question: What did the villagers put on the sand?
options: Dry straw in square grids
Wet paper in big boxes
Plastic bags and bottles
Salt water from the sea
questions.explanation_cn: 第四句说 villagers put dry straw into square grids（把干稻草铺成方格），草就在方格里长出来。

questions.question: What happens inside the grids after the straw work?
options: Grass grows back
The sand turns into stone
The river moves away
The desert gets bigger
questions.explanation_cn: 第四句后半说 grass came back inside the grids（方格里长回了草）。

spell.question: 烧烤：b_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: barbecue 读 /ˈbɑːbɪkjuː/，重音在最前，口语里常简写成 BBQ。

spell.question: 观众：a_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: audience 读 /ˈɔːdiəns/，开头 au 读 /ɔː/，集合名词「观众们」。

spell.question: 气球：b______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: balloon 有两个 o，结尾双 l：bal + loon。

writing_drill.title: 第 6 句 · 结尾 + 全文回顾开头
writing_drill.focus_cn: See you tomorrow! 读出开心的语气，结尾署名 Tom

sentences.en: Dear Lucy, I am so happy to go shopping with you tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 亲爱的Lucy，明天能和你一起去购物我太开心了。
